tool.title: Resolve a review thread on a pull request (GitHub)
tool.description: Mark one review thread on a pull request as resolved. A GitHub thread id names its pull request, so no number is needed.

inputs.name: thread
inputs.description: The review thread's node id, e.g. PRRT_kwDO…

remedies.none: No declared Tool reaches the GitHub API another way. A session that provides the GitHub MCP server can use it instead.

$comment.comment:
`gh` has no command for this: it is the GraphQL mutation `resolveReviewThread`,
whose text carries `$id`, which a shell would expand. So the command is a
script key, and the script (in the tools layer) calls `gh` with an argument
array. No query text is ever typed into a shell.
